title: Review of c18's r-two56 cogs at R=15: the A1 shell band survives on fresh seed 3 (band r=12, trough r=5, 160 cell-frames), and here ~10 cogs persist at constant size to t=1000; Supported for B
summary: I looked at radial_r15_seed0.png, localcut_r15.png and pack_r15/seed0/sheet.png, then ran the finding's world.py with WORLD_P {"R":15} (288^2) on seed 3 with labkit (t=1000) and applied the author's radial_cog.py. Cogs form from full-domain noise by t~85 and from t~220 about 10 isolated cogs keep their size to t=1000 (labkit 10 final components, 9 persistent tracks, persistent area ratio 1.24; rerun/seed3/sheet.png). radial_cog.py over 160 isolated cell-frames: A1 1.0 at the centre, trough 0.0 at r=5, shell band 0.97 at r=12, outside (r=25-29) 0.0004, the 1.5x scaling of the R=10 profile (trough r=3, band r=7-8) that the finding reports. labkit's centroid radial reads A1 as peaked at the centre (rim/core 1.31, 0/55 membrane-like) because of the bright centre spot, so the band measure is needed here as the author says. Unlike the author's seeds 0 and 1 (3 and 6 cogs left), seed 3 shows no spontaneous cog deaths after t~220.

observations.B: data/radial_r15_seed3.json and radial_r15_seed3.png: A1 trough 0.0 at r=5, band 0.97 at r=12, outside 0.0004, 160 isolated cell-frames; rerun/seed3/sheet.png t=220-1000: ~10 stable shelled cogs

seeds_run.result: pass: shell band at r=12; 10 cogs persist to t=1000

controls_run.B: none of my own; the k4 ablation and the local food cut are the author's (localcut_r15.json, seed 2)

not_checked: the local food cut at R=15
the k4 shell ablation at R=15
verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed; I did not repeat the fork. The cog persistence limit the author reports (3 and 6 survivors) did not appear on seed 3, so spontaneous deaths at R=15 are seed-dependent. The radial plot's title says R=10 (a label in radial_cog.py), but the run is R=15.
